OSKAR HADDAD-LINDQVIST
Full-Stack Developer | TypeScript, React, Node.js

oskar.hl@example.com | +46 70 555 0808 | GitHub: oskarhl-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-stack developer with professional web development experience since 2014, currently building customer onboarding features with React, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. Experience includes identity verification, accessibility improvements, mobile performance optimisation and AWS deployments. Fluent in English and experienced in collaborating with designers and cross-functional teams.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Full-Stack Developer | Älvgrind Fintech AB | 2021–Present
- Develop customer onboarding and KYC flows in a six-person cross-functional team using React, TypeScript, NestJS and PostgreSQL.
- Built a BankID identity verification flow, including QR codes, error handling and retries. Onboarding conversion increased from 61% to 74% after an A/B test and rollout.
- Built a document upload flow using S3 presigned URLs, virus scanning in Lambda, SQS and PostgreSQL.
- Improved mobile Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 to 1.9 seconds through measures including code splitting, image optimisation and dependency replacement.
- Addressed accessibility audit findings against WCAG 2.1 AA in the onboarding flow and collaborated with designers using Figma.
- Helped migrate Express services to NestJS and migrated the frontend from Create React App to Vite. Maintains a GraphQL backend for frontend with another developer.
- Worked with AWS ECS Fargate, Docker, GitHub Actions, feature flags, Jest and Playwright; participated in an on-call rotation.
- The onboarding team received an internal customer impact award in 2023.

Developer | Sjöbris Digital Agency AB | 2018–2021
- Built websites and web applications for approximately 25 clients using React, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, Express and PHP.
- Served as project tech lead and one of two developers on a React Native ferry ticketing app with approximately 50,000 downloads.
- Set up GitLab CI for the agency and developed WordPress themes and plugins.

Web Developer | Nordkust Media AB | 2014–2018
- Developed newspaper websites and a paywall integration using PHP, jQuery and MySQL.
- Worked on an AngularJS article editor, Varnish caching and Ubuntu server administration.

Freelance Web Developer | 2012–2014
- Built PHP, jQuery and WordPress websites for individuals and local clients while studying.

SKILLS
Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Next.js, Storybook, Angular, React Native
Backend and databases: Node.js, NestJS, Express, REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma, Redis
Cloud and delivery: AWS ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS and CloudWatch; Docker; GitHub Actions; GitLab CI
Testing and collaboration: Jest, Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library, Supertest, Figma, Agile/Scrum

EDUCATION
Bachelor in Computer Science | West Coast University College, Gothenburg | 2011–2014

ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE
Mentor, coding bootcamp, Gothenburg | 2019–2020
Speaker, local JavaScript meetup: “Migrating Express to NestJS without stopping the world” | 2022

LANGUAGES
Swedish: native | English: fluent, used at work | Arabic: spoken

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear chronological experience, relevant technical detail, measurable outcomes, and professional language. The strongest evidence includes the onboarding conversion increase from 61% to 74%, mobile LCP improvement from 4.1 to 1.9 seconds, the 50,000-download React Native app, and the internal customer impact award. The document is concise without omitting the candidate’s main responsibilities. A small content weakness is that the summary does not surface several highly relevant strengths already documented elsewhere, particularly automated testing, Git-based CI workflows, WCAG work, and A/B testing.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses conventional section headings, reverse-chronological employment history, standard bullets, and searchable technology names, so it should parse reliably in most ATS platforms. Keyword coverage is strong for React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Jest, Playwright, Storybook, accessibility, and A/B testing. AI screening probability is high because the recent role closely matches the target stack and responsibilities. ATS alignment could be improved by explicitly connecting testing tools to unit and end-to-end testing, explicitly naming CI/Git-based workflows in the experience section, and making the GitHub reference a complete clickable URL rather than only a username.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The candidate is a strong match for the core engineering requirements. The CV clearly demonstrates more than two years of professional React and TypeScript experience; Node.js backend development and SQL databases; accessibility work against WCAG 2.1 AA; Jest and Playwright testing; AWS and Docker; Next.js; Storybook; and A/B testing. KYC and identity-verification work provide relevant experience in a security-sensitive and regulated fintech context, although direct healthcare or health-data privacy experience is not shown. The document also supports the company’s collaboration signals through cross-functional teamwork, designer collaboration, Figma, mentoring, and speaking/knowledge-sharing activities. Web-security fundamentals such as OWASP Top 10 are not explicitly demonstrated, and the CV does not show willingness to learn health-data privacy requirements; these are candidate-profile gaps or unverified areas rather than defects that should be filled with unsupported claims. German is listed only as forgotten school-level knowledge in the original material, and Croatian is not present.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL / HIGH-VALUE IMPROVEMENTS
1. In the Professional Summary, add the strongest job-specific evidence already present in the CV. For example, revise the summary to mention automated unit and end-to-end testing with Jest and Playwright, GitHub Actions-based delivery, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility work, and A/B-tested onboarding improvements. Keep the existing React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, customer onboarding, and performance points, but make the summary more directly match the target role.

2. In the Älvgrind Fintech AB experience section, revise the bullet beginning "Worked with AWS ECS Fargate" so that it explicitly states the testing and delivery practices supported by the source material. For example: "Worked with AWS ECS Fargate, Docker and GitHub Actions; wrote and maintained Jest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end tests; participated in feature-flagged releases and an on-call rotation." Only retain the testing wording if the candidate is comfortable confirming that they personally wrote or maintained those tests.

3. In the Skills section under "Testing and collaboration," change the wording to make the job-ad concepts more searchable: "Automated testing: Jest (unit), Playwright (end-to-end), Cypress, React Testing Library, Supertest; Collaboration and delivery: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Figma, Agile/Scrum." Do not label any tool as unit or end-to-end unless that accurately reflects the candidate’s use.

4. In the Experience section under Älvgrind Fintech AB, make the security-sensitive nature of the existing work more explicit without claiming unsupported OWASP expertise. For example, change "Built a BankID identity verification flow" to "Built a BankID identity-verification flow for KYC onboarding, including QR codes, error handling and retries," and retain the existing document-upload bullet with S3 presigned URLs and Lambda virus scanning. This better connects the candidate’s real fintech experience to the role’s security and privacy context.

MINOR ATS / PRESENTATION ENHANCEMENTS
5. In the contact line at the top, replace "GitHub: oskarhl-example" with the complete GitHub profile URL if available, using a clean format such as "github.com/oskarhl-example." This improves recruiter usability and link extraction without adding unsupported information.

6. In the Skills section, consider changing "Cloud and delivery" to "Cloud, DevOps and CI/CD" because the document supports AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions and GitLab CI. This is a clearer match to the job description’s cloud and Git-based workflow terminology.
